depth_check: hit point = probe + direction*hit_distance; predicted view depth = probe_depth + dot(dir,forward)*distance; compared with SceneDepthZ at the projected pixel (<5% passes)
sh_unit_note: raw EvaluateSHIrradiance output is not physical irradiance; physical irradiance = 4*pi*raw, and the single-probe unit-albedo Lambert response = 4*raw; captured per-pixel DiffuseIndirect additionally includes spatial integration and active occlusion rules
sh_replay_tile_check_note: the 16x16 tile is a valid single-probe approximation on the planar A/B floor (median ~2% for 4*raw vs captured DiffuseIndirect); at C it spans a curved metal sphere plus background, so only the centre-pixel comparison is used

ray_layout.structured_trace_slot: 8x8 per-probe RayInfo/TraceRadiance/TraceHit layout; [i,j] is a structured trace slot
ray_layout.regular_reconstructed_field: ScreenProbeRadiance is the regular reconstructed angular field; [i,j] is not the filtered value of the structured ray at the same integer slot
ray_layout.figure_rule: screenprobe_rays_A uses radiance_trace_native for line colour; filtered radiance is shown only in its own labelled regular-field panel

validity.note: shader parameter payload, not an RDG resource version; DumpGPU does not attach a DumpReadbackStatus record to this structure payload

screenprobe_parameters.address_mapping: FScreenProbeParameters starts at byte 64 of the captured FParameters payload; field addresses are 64+metadata Offset

blue_noise_uniform.address_mapping: wrapped texture coordinate = ((screenTileX & maskX), (frame & maskZ)*dimY + (screenTileY & maskY))
